entries.def:
κρίσις, -εως, ἡ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט, also for רִיב, etc. ;] 
__1. a seperating, selection (Arist., al.) 
__2. a decision, judgment (cl.): Jhn.8.16, 1Ti.5.24, 2Pe.2.11, Jude.9; κ. κρίνειν, Jhn.7.24 in forensic sense, Act.8.33 (LXX) (see Page, in l); esp. of the Divine judgment, Jhn.3.19; 5.24, 27; 5.29-30; 12.31; 16.8, 11, 2Th.1.5, Heb.10.27, Jas.2.13; 5.12, 2Pe.2.4, Rev.18.10; pl., Rev.16.7; 19.2;…

κριτήριον, -ου, τό
(κριτής), [in LXX: 1Ki.7.7 (מִשְׁפָּט), Dan LXX TH Dan.7.10, 26, (דִּין), Sus.1.49, Exo.21.6, Jdg.5.10 * ;] 
__1. a means of judging, test, criterion. 
__2. a tribunal: 1Co.6.2; 6.4, Jas.2.6.†
(AS)

κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַט ;] 
a judge: Mat.5.25, Luk.12.14, 58; 18.2; τ. ἀδικίας, Luk.18.6 with gem of thing(s) (obj.), Act.18.15, Jas.4.11; (qual.), διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν, Jas.2.4 of a Roman procurator, Act.24.10 of God, Heb.12.23, Jas.4.12; Christ, Act.10.42, 2Ti.4.8, Jas.5.9; of those whose conduct is made a standard for judging, Mat.12.27, Luk.11.19; in the OT sense (Jdg.2.16, Rut.1.1,…

κριτικός, -ή, -όν
(κρίνω), 
critical, able to discern or judge: with genitive obj., Heb.4.12.†
(AS)

Κρούω 
[in LXX: before ἐπί Jdg.19.22, Sng.5.2 (דָּפַק) ;] 
with, accusative, τ. αὐλαίαν, Jdt.14.14 * ;] 
to strike, knock: at a door (Κόπτειν, in Att..), Mat.7.7-8, Luk.11.9-10; 12.36, Act.12.16, Rev.3.20; with accusative, τ. θύραν, Luk.13.25, Act.12.13.†
(AS)

κρύπτη (WH, R; κρυπτή, LT, Tr.; -όν, Rec.), -ης, ἡ, 
a crypt, cellar: Luk.11.33.†
(AS)

κρυπτός, -ή, -όν
(κρύπτω) [in LXX for אָטַם, מִסְתָּר, etc. ;] 
hidden, secret: Mat.10.26, Mrk.4.22, Luk.8.17; 12.2; ὁ κ. τῆς καρδίας ἄνθρωπος, 1Pe.3.4 neut., ἐν τῷ κ., Mat.6.4, 6; ἐν κ., Jhn.7.4, 10; 18.20; ὁ ἐν κ. Ἰουδαῖος, Rom.2.29 pl., τὰ κ. τ. σκότους, 1Co.4.5 τ. ἀνθρώπων, Rom.2.16 τ. καρδίας, 1Co.14.25 τ. αἰσχύνης, 2Co.4.2.†
κρυφαῖος, -αία, -αῖον 
(κρύφα = κρυφῆ) [in LXX for מִסְתָּר, Jer.23.24, al. ;] …

Κρύπτω 
[in LXX for חָבָא, טָמַן, סָתַר, צָפַן, etc. ;] 
to hide, conceal: with accusative, Mat.13.44; 25.18; before ἐν, Mat.25.25 (pass., Mat.13.44, Col.3.3); pass., Mat.5.14, Heb.11.23, 1Ti.5.25, Rev.2.17; ἐκρύβη (on the tense and its formation, see M, Pr., 161; Bl., § 19, 3) κ. ἐξῆλθεν Jhn.8.59 before εἰς, Luk.13.21, Rev.6.15; ἀπό (in cl. more frequently dupl. accusative), Rev.6.16 pass., Jhn.12.36, (Bl., § 34,…

κρυσταλλίζω
(κρύσταλλος), 
to shine like crystal, be crystal-clear: Rev.21.11 (ἅπ, λεγ.).†
(AS)
